description: This file is a shell script used for platform upgrade procedures in the OpenWRT project, specifically for the xrx200_legacy base files on Lantiq hardware. It implements functions to check the image and perform upgrades based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade based on the board's name, defaults to calling 'default_do_upgrade'.
